text: Residents on Highland Crescent continue to experience serious traffic safety issues, driven largely by traffic infiltration caused by high volumes of traffic on York Mills Road and Bayview Avenue, and the routing of traffic through the neighbourhood by navigation apps. Many of the vehicles exceed the local speed limits. Two community petitions showed very strong support for traffic calming in the form of speed humps for Highland Crescent both between York Mills Road and Birchwood Avenue, as well as between Birchwood Avenue and Bayview Avenue. This motion seeks authorization for Transportation Services to install speed humps, as an added traffic calming measure, to deter such behaviour and ensure motorists maintain safe speeds while traveling through the neighbourhood. North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (eleven speed humps) on Highland Crescent, between Beechwood Avenue and Bayview Avenue, generally as shown in Drawing Numbers TC-775, TC-775-1, TC-776 and TC-776-1, dated June 2026, from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, in the attachment to the Letter (June 18, 2026) from Councillor Rachel Chernos Lin.
